intelligence.essence: Never describe the image. Every slide, over and over: this is what it is · this is why it matters · this is what's in it for you. Clear, direct, warm and inviting, not long. The captain writes it herself, intentionally, matched to its image — agents are never left to put whatever in there. If the text won't fit beautifully with its image, it runs onto the next slide on Keep Reading; a text-only slide is proper, two in a row are okay. And by the end, a child should understand it.
